messages:
Sam: Quick scrub — INC-472 postmortem has a handful of actions with fuzzy ownership. Can folks confirm owners + realistic due dates? Need this before the canary next Tue.
Maya: I can take infra-facing work (networking changes + firewall rule). Target EOD Thu? :calendar:
Ali: I’ll pick up the model rollback checklist and testing harness fixes. Can do Mon EOD if no blockers.
Rekha: I owned the telemetry fixes but flagged a dependency on eng-ml for the schema change. ETA depends on that — only partial until schema is stable.
Sam: OK note on the dependency. Re: telemetry schema — who on eng-ml can confirm timeline?
Leo: @Ali I can help with the model testing infra, esp the nightly job flakiness. If you share the failing run ids I’ll triage tomorrow AM.
Ali: Thanks @Leo — will drop the run ids in a follow-up. For clarity, my action: "validate rollback + update canary script" due Mon 1800 PT.
Maya: My infra action: "apply firewall rule + validate cross-region routing" due Thu 1700 PT. I'll post the change doc link.
Rekha: Eng-ml dependency: @Maya we need the new telemetry header before we can finish the ingest fix. Eng-ml sprint has it slated for Fri. If that slips, my ETA becomes Tue next week.
Sam: Let's list as actions in one block so the incident tracker can be updated. Please confirm exact Slack handle in parentheses.

```
- ACTION 1: Apply firewall rule & validate routing — Owner: Maya (maya) — Due: 1799999200 (Thu 17:00 PT)
- ACTION 2: Validate rollback + update canary script — Owner: Ali (ali) — Due: 1799998800 (Mon 18:00 PT)
- ACTION 3: Telemetry ingest fix (blocked by schema) — Owner: Rekha (rekha) — Due: dependent on eng-ml (est Fri or Tue if blocked)
- ACTION 4: Nightly job triage & flaky test suppression — Owner: Leo (leo) — Due: 1799999400 (Tue 10:00 PT)
```

Maya: I'll add the change doc: https://redwood-internal/docs/inc-472/fw-rule-diff :lock:
Ali: FYI the rollback script change is tiny; main risk is the canary config mismatch — will include a smoke checklist.
Rekha: If eng-ml can't land header by Fri, can someone from infra mock the header for staging? That would let me finish the ingest fix.
Maya: I can mock it in staging env in <30m. Will mark that as contingency in the change doc.
Sam: Great. Two quick asks: (1) can each owner paste the final string I should put in the tracker (one-line owner + due ts) and (2) if anyone needs an accelerated review from product/security, ping them now.
Leo: My tracker line: "Leo — Nightly triage & flaky test suppression — due 1799999400" :white_check_mark:
Ali: Tracker: "Ali — Validate rollback & update canary script — due 1799998800".
Maya: Tracker: "Maya — Apply firewall rule & validate cross-region routing — due 1799999200".
Rekha: Tracker: "Rekha — Telemetry ingest fix (blocked by eng-ml schema) — tentative due Fri, will update if blocked".
SRE-Bot: Reminder: 3 actions currently have external dependencies. Please update the incident tracker when statuses change. :robot_face:
Sam: Thanks — I’ll update the tracker and ping product/security if anything needs expedited review. If eng-ml confirms the header today, Rekha can keep the Fri ETA; otherwise she'll update the tracker to Tue next week.
Maya: thumbs-up :thumbsup: will post confirmation once rule is scheduled.
Ali: will post run ids shortly and start the rollback validation ASAP.
Sam: Perfect. Closing this thread for now — update the tracker and reopen if blockers surface. :eyes:
